question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• We need a verb that appropriately completes the action performed by "other (4) _________ present at the event" towards the protagonists of the passage.
 
• The verb 'appreciated' meaning 'recognized the full worth of' is apt in this context as it refers to the acknowledgement of the successful efforts in reducing child marriages.
 
• The context of the passage is the celebration or acknowledgement of the NGO's achievements, making 'appreciated' a strong fit, as it directly signifies an expression of approval or admiration.
 
• In the context of the sentence, 'appreciated' also works well because it conveys a specific action performed by others, aligning with the statement that the Chief of Police came up and congratulated them.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: '* 'It was a matter of immense pleasure that the Chief of Police himself came up to us and congratulated us on our successful efforts in reducing the number of child marriages in our area. We were also **appreciated** by other (4) _________ present at the event. Our dear leader, the founder of our NGO, Mr. Kumar was (5) _________ by the mayor with a bouquet.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Understood': This verb denotes that something is comprehended or grasped. It is not directly indicative of an expression of positive acknowledgement or approval which is implied by the context.
 
• 'Valued': While this verb can refer to the estimation of something's worth, it doesn't strongly convey a specific action of expressed appreciation which aligns with the passage.
 
• 'Respected': Respect can be part of appreciation, but by itself, it doesn't necessarily imply a positive response to a specific achievement.
